transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.help: What listens to the whole stream, to find the moments, then for the subtitles. If this computer or Groq gets stuck, OpenRouter takes over.
transcription.groqHint: The fastest: a 7-hour stream in under a minute, about 4 cents per hour of stream. On the free tier, its hourly limit hands the rest to OpenRouter.
transcription.groqNeedsKey: Add a Groq key above to use it.
transcription.openrouterHint: No extra key. About 1 cent per hour of stream, a few minutes for a whole stream.
transcription.localGpu: Free and fast, on your NVIDIA graphics card.
transcription.localMlx: Free and fast, on your Mac's chip.
transcription.localCpu: Free, but slow here (no NVIDIA card or Apple chip): about real time.
transcription.localUnknown: Free, and fast with an NVIDIA card or an Apple chip.
transcription.download: The model (1.6 GB) downloads once, on the first analysis.
